svg.title: Correct, quarantine, block, compensate
svg.desc: A four-step flow: correct a fact, quarantine everything built on it, block dependent actions, compensate those that already ran.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One step in; four effects out. All of it is a graph operation, none of it asks a model.
